# Captured Zink regression modules

These SPIR-V modules were captured from Mesa 25.0.7 Zink at Vulkan shader
creation during the Scarlet integration run. They are test inputs, not an
ICD runtime dependency. No proprietary game assets are included.

`triangle.*` and `texture.*` originate in the Scarlet Linux Zink EGL probe
(`guest_tests/linux_zink/egl.c`). They exercise PointSize, sparse descriptors,
combined samplers, interpolation, and component-packed inputs.

`openttd*` originate in the OpenTTD 15.3 palette/sprite GLSL programs, translated
by Zink. Their corresponding source is included as `openttd-source.h`, copied
without modification from OpenTTD 15.3 `src/table/opengl_shader.h` at official
commit `14ec60f248547d4d062a1160f0fc26d742319888`. Those source and generated
fixture files retain OpenTTD's GPL-2.0-only license; see `OpenTTD-COPYING.md`.
This does not relicense the surrounding MIT implementation.

Upstream source: https://github.com/OpenTTD/OpenTTD/tree/15.3
Mesa source: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/tree/mesa-25.0.7
The captures are reproducible by tracing vkCreateShaderModule during the
corresponding EGL probe or OpenTTD `-v sdl-opengl` run; generated bytes can
vary with compiler flags. SHA256 values in `sha256.json` identify these inputs.
